title: Yoshi's New Island
shortDescription: Yoshi's New Island helps define a Nintendo 3DS family platformer path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Offers a clearly labeled platformer route through the Nintendo 3DS family collection.
Links the catalog entry to a source record without presenting a rating.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Indexed for the Nintendo 3DS family platformer discovery path using a Wikidata-listed catalog relationship; this remains a labeled reference path, not a popularity claim.
